task.title: Review the Guided profile
task.shortdesc: Use Step 6 to review the configuration in plain language before handoff.

prereq.p: You have finished the Guided changes you want to keep.

context.p: The review step helps you catch missing schema choices, validation warnings, and settings that do not match the scenario.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Read the selected profile summary and changed setting groups.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Resolve validation warnings or document why a supported exception remains.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Confirm that the scenario, CIS layer, schema channel, and edited controls match the handoff goal.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile is ready to save, download, or continue editing with a clear review trail.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the review reveals a mismatch, return to the owning step and correct it before saving.
